home.heroText: Organize cross-border freight with confidence and keep each step clearly recorded, from receiving cargo to delivery.
home.servicesIntro: We coordinate transport based on your cargo details, including its weight, dimensions, and delivery requirements.
home.s1Text: We coordinate cargo transport from Erenhot to Ulaanbaatar with our contracted freight partners.
home.s2Text: Cargo arriving in Erenhot is recorded and received, then organized for dispatch on a scheduled trip.
home.s3Text: Key cargo milestones—from receiving and loading to arrival in Ulaanbaatar—are recorded.
home.s4Text: Cargo quantities, weight, and volume help us plan trip assignments and transport arrangements.
home.processTitle: A clear journey, one step at a time
home.processText: Send us a quote request and prepare your cargo details. We will follow up to discuss transport availability and terms.
home.step3: Hand over cargo at the Erenhot receiving point
home.contactHint: Share the cargo type and estimated weight and volume. We will follow up about your quote request.
